_meta.placeholders: Curly-brace tokens such as {current}, {total}, {vars}, {interval}, {lessonTitle} are interpolated at runtime.

layoutFlexNotes.issue: Sequence lane column is fixed at 88px on desktop and 56px at <=720px (04-IMPLEMENTATION.md notes 72px at 360px). English lane labels within the <=6 width limit (up to 12 ASCII chars, e.g. 'Microtasks', 'Call stack') need ~76-96px.
layoutFlexNotes.recommendation: Use minmax(88px, max-content) (capped at 112px) on desktop and 72px on 360px with text-overflow: ellipsis.

layoutFlexNotes.issue: Compare row label column is 72px on desktop and 64px on 360px. English row labels within <=8 width (up to 16 ASCII chars, e.g. 'Starts at', '1st call') reach ~72-80px.
layoutFlexNotes.recommendation: Flex column 1 to minmax(72px, 88px) on desktop and minmax(68px, 80px) on 360px.

layoutFlexNotes.issue: Timeline row label column drops to 44px on 360px. English labels like 'Timer 1' or 'Input' (<=6 width) are ~48-52px wide at 13px font.
layoutFlexNotes.recommendation: Widen mobile label track from 44px to 56px (desktop 64px -> 68px).

layoutFlexNotes.issue: English post-rating status 'Got it · Reviews start later' (~28 chars) or 'Not sure · Demo lessons aren't queued' (~37 chars) sits alongside the 'Recall' header on 360px.
layoutFlexNotes.recommendation: Allow flex-wrap: wrap; row-gap: 4px; on .recall-top so .state-note wraps cleanly below on narrow screens. Use compact wrapUp.statusWaiting ('Starts later') inside .recap li .r where white-space: nowrap applies.

layoutFlexNotes.issue: English 'Think first' is slightly wider than '先想再看', though hidden via .wide at <=720px.
layoutFlexNotes.recommendation: Keep white-space: nowrap on .chip-btn; in the <=720px overflow menu, allow full-width menu rows.

assumptions: In-lesson recall scheduling (P3 backend server/learning.ts rateRecall, ts-fsrs, 9f5a0fb): first rating schedules Good (記得) ~10 min out and Again (不確定) ~1 min out, growing across later reviews; due can also be in the past when reopening an earlier lesson. Because scheduled.dueNow (待複習 / Due for review) is used whenever due - now falls within the backend's early-review window (~20 min, LEARN_AHEAD_MS), the first 記得 (~10 min out) shows 記得 · 待複習 / Got it · Due for review because the card is already in the review queue. Confirmation copy always reflects the real RecallState (scheduled + due, waiting for 記得 past the daily cap, or demo) and never promises a fixed day count.

Scheduled due buckets (local clock relative to now, using the ~20 min early-review window LEARN_AHEAD_MS): due - now within the ~20 min early-review window (including due <= now) -> dueNow (待複習 / Due for review); past the ~20 min window through 59 min -> minutes; 1-5 hr on the same calendar day (or <6 hr overnight) -> hours; >=6 hr on the same calendar day -> todayAt (or day-only today); next local calendar day -> tomorrowAt (or day-only tomorrow); >=2 local calendar days -> days (n >= 2).

Daily new-card cap (server/learning.ts 9f5a0fb: max 3 new cards/lesson/day, 15/day total): only 記得 (Good) rated past today's new-card limit returns status "waiting" (記得 · 之後開始複習 / Got it · Reviews start later; wrap-up pill wrapUp.statusWaiting: 之後開始複習 / Starts later; optional tooltip recall.waitingTooltip), joining review on the first later day with room. 不確定 (Again) is a miss and is always scheduled immediately without using the daily allowance, so it is never "waiting". The backend never returns "tomorrow".

Failed v3 restructure (server/ai.ts, shared/types.ts failedFormat: 3, server/sync.ts): when v3 validation fails twice or the source exceeds the v3 prompt limit, the complete note is saved in the classic layout with badge 整理失敗 / Couldn't format. Because L1.7 (更多 › 整理成新格式) is not yet wired in LegacyNoteReader, reformatFailedTooltip tells learners they can read as is or try again from the original source; reformatFailedTooltipRebuild is provided ready for when L1.7 lands, and reformatFailedSyncHeld covers sync holding format-3 / failedFormat-3 notes locally against an un-updated sync server.

End-of-lesson Wrap-up (04-IMPLEMENTATION P3.7, ol.v3-recap): rows report recall outcome rather than next due time—statusRemembered (記得 / Got it), statusUnsure (不確定 / Not sure), statusWaiting (之後開始複習 / Starts later, when 記得 hits the daily new-card cap), or statusUnanswered (未回想 / Not tried). Because freshly rated cards almost all land inside the 20-min early-review window, repeating due times or demo flags on every row adds no signal; wrapUp.statusDueNow, wrapUp.statusAskToday, and wrapUp.statusDemo were removed so P3.7 stays strictly outcome-based.

SelfCheck under Follow-ups (04-IMPLEMENTATION P0.5) & legacy check cards: in legacy lessons, optional free-response checking sits under 延伸問題 / Go further (disconnected-model notice shown at most once per lesson), while missed questions enter Review with card kind "check" labeled 自我檢查 / Self-check (review.kindCheckLegacy, matching ReviewSession.tsx KIND_LABELS.check). Format-3 lessons never create "check" cards—their 延伸問題 are branch-to-new-lesson prompts only.

scansNeedPassword.zh-TW: 所選範圍都是沒有文字層的頁面，請輸入 PDF 密碼以附上頁面影像。
scansNeedPassword.en: Selected pages have no text layer. Enter the PDF password to include page images.

unsupportedType.zh-TW: 請選擇 PDF、DOCX、PPTX、TXT 或 Markdown 檔案。
unsupportedType.en: Choose a PDF, DOCX, PPTX, TXT, or Markdown file.

emptyFile.zh-TW: 這份檔案是空的，請選擇有內容的檔案。
emptyFile.en: This file is empty. Choose a file with content.

fileTooLarge.zh-TW: 檔案超過 {maxMb} MB，請先分成較小的章節再上傳。
fileTooLarge.en: This file is over {maxMb} MB. Split it into smaller parts and try again.

singleFileOnly.zh-TW: 一次解釋一份檔案，請先選擇其中一份。
singleFileOnly.en: Explain one file at a time. Pick one to start.

readFailed.zh-TW: 無法讀取檔案，請重新嘗試。
readFailed.en: Couldn't read this file. Try again.

cancelFailedToast.en: Couldn't cancel right now. Try again in a moment.

preparing.zh-TW: 正在準備你的學習內容…

preparingSample.zh-TW: 正在開啟人工編寫的互動示範…

savedToast.zh-TW: 解說已儲存到你的知識庫

failedFallback.en: Couldn't finish this explanation. Try again in a bit.

resumedUnknownToast.zh-TW: 上次的解說狀態無法確認（伺服器可能已重新啟動），請到知識庫查看或重新開始。
resumedUnknownToast.en: Couldn't confirm your previous lesson (the server may have restarted). Check your Library or start again.

otherTabTitle.zh-TW: 在其他分頁或裝置開始的解說
otherTabTitle.en: Started in another tab or device

deepReadingTitle.zh-TW: 深度解析在伺服器上進行，離開頁面不會停止
deepReadingTitle.en: Runs on the server and keeps going if you leave this page

stopFailedToast.en: Couldn't stop right now. Try again in a moment.

errorAria.zh-TW: 複習數量讀取失敗，點選即可重試
errorAria.en: Couldn't load review count. Select to try again.

errorTooltip.zh-TW: 複習數量讀取失敗，點選即可重試
errorTooltip.en: Couldn't load review count. Select to try again.

staleWithRetry.zh-TW: 上次成功的資料 · 重試

emptyMatchTitle.zh-TW: 還沒有找到相符的筆記

emptyMatchBody.zh-TW: 換個關鍵字，或開始一段新的學習。
emptyMatchBody.en: Try another keyword, or start a new lesson.

emptyLibraryBody.zh-TW: 貼上程式碼、文章或檔案，完成後就會收進這裡。
emptyLibraryBody.en: Start an explanation from code, an article, or a file, and it'll show up here.

emptySavedTitle.zh-TW: 收藏讓你想再看一次的理解

emptySavedBody.zh-TW: 點選筆記上的星號，就可以收藏。
emptySavedBody.en: Select the star on any note to keep it here.

emptyTitle.zh-TW: 第一個知識節點，從你開始
emptyTitle.en: Your knowledge map starts with a first note

emptyBody.zh-TW: 完成一篇解說後，主題與筆記的連結就會出現在這裡。
emptyBody.en: Finish an explanation and its topics and links will show up here.

viewportAria.zh-TW: 可水平平移的知識圖譜

canvasAria.zh-TW: 互動知識圖譜，點選筆記開啟，點選主題篩選
canvasAria.en: Interactive knowledge map: select a note to open it, or select a topic to filter

canvasHint.zh-TW: 拖曳旋轉 3D 球體 · 拉動微點牽引關聯 · 滾輪縮放 · 點選檢視概念脈絡
canvasHint.en: Drag to spin 3D sphere · Pull nodes · Scroll to zoom · Click to inspect

orbitToggleAria.zh-TW: 切換 3D 球體自動旋轉

emptyFiltered.zh-TW: 沒有符合篩選條件的節點

noConnections.zh-TW: 尚無直接跨篇連結，可點選下方主題探索相近概念。
noConnections.en: No direct note links yet. Select a shared topic below to explore related ideas.

relationParentReason.zh-TW: 這篇是讀完它之後的延伸問題。
relationParentReason.en: Answers a follow-up question from this note.

relationChildReason.zh-TW: 從這篇的追問延伸出來。
relationChildReason.en: Grew out of a follow-up question on this note.

locationLabelLocal.zh-TW: 授權讀取的 repository 根資料夾（絕對路徑）

emptyBody.zh-TW: 加入公開 GitHub 網址或本機資料夾，就能針對整個專案提問。
emptyBody.en: Add a public GitHub link or local repo folder to ask questions across the codebase.

updateTitle.zh-TW: 讀取來源目前的 HEAD，另外建立索引並保留舊版本。
updateTitle.en: Index the current HEAD while keeping earlier snapshots.

updateBusyTitle.zh-TW: 相同來源已有索引工作，請等待完成。
updateBusyTitle.en: An index job for this repo is already running.

updateKeepNote.zh-TW: 更新會保留舊 commit，另外建立最新版本的索引。
updateKeepNote.en: Updating keeps earlier commits and adds a new snapshot for the latest version.

deleteGroupAria.zh-TW: 確認移除 repository 索引

deleteBody.zh-TW: 會刪除此版本的檔案、搜尋分段與向量快取；進行中的索引工作也會取消。已儲存的教學筆記及其中的來源快照會保留。其他 commit 版本不受影響。
deleteBody.en: This deletes the indexed files and search cache for this snapshot and stops any running job. Your saved lessons and other commit snapshots stay intact.

scopeTruncatedSummary.zh-TW: 索引範圍與限制 · 部分文字檔未收錄
scopeTruncatedSummary.en: Scope and limits · Some text files omitted

scopeLimitsBody.zh-TW: 每個專案最多 10,000 個合格檔案、50 MB 文字與 60,000 分段；每檔最多 250 KB。索引完成後，AI 會依問題取出相關段落，來源筆記會保留實際使用範圍。
scopeLimitsBody.en: Up to 10,000 eligible files, 50 MB of text, and 60,000 sections per repo (250 KB per file). When you ask a question, AI pulls in matching sections and records the exact lines used.

fileSearchAria.zh-TW: 搜尋全部索引檔案路徑

filePreviewLoading.zh-TW: 讀取 commit 中的檔案…

citationsEmpty.zh-TW: 引用範圍：空白檔案沒有文字分段

filePendingFallback.en: This file is still waiting to be indexed.

selectFilePrompt.zh-TW: 選擇檔案，核對實際內容與行號。
selectFilePrompt.en: Select a file to inspect its contents and line numbers.

questionLabel.en: What part would you like to understand first?

questionPlaceholder.zh-TW: 例如：從使用者送出請求開始，資料經過哪些函式？請搭配動畫解釋。
questionPlaceholder.en: e.g. Trace how a request flows through the functions from start to finish.

readyNote.zh-TW: 會使用此 commit 中可引用的分段，生成完整教學筆記。
readyNote.en: Builds a lesson from citable sections in this snapshot.

waitingNote.zh-TW: 索引完成後即可生成教學筆記。
waitingNote.en: You can start a lesson once indexing finishes.

serviceUnreachable.en: Repo Index isn't responding right now.

alreadyIndexing.zh-TW: 這個來源已有索引工作進行中，已切換到該工作。
alreadyIndexing.en: This repo is already being indexed. Switched to that job.

closure.zh-TW: 函式為什麼能記得外面的變數

debounce.zh-TW: 連續輸入後只送出最後一次請求
debounce.en: Sending only the last request while typing

asyncOrder.zh-TW: 非同步工作按照什麼順序執行
asyncOrder.en: What order async tasks run in

modeKeywordTitle.zh-TW: 尚未啟用語意向量，依文字內容比對
modeKeywordTitle.en: Semantic search isn't enabled yet; matching exact words

enableSemanticHint.zh-TW: 在設定中啟用多語向量模型，就能搜尋用不同文字描述的相關概念。
enableSemanticHint.en: Turn on semantic search in Settings to find related ideas phrased in different words.

empty.zh-TW: 目前沒有相符的段落，試試其他概念或先建立筆記與 Repo 索引。
empty.en: No matching passages yet. Try another phrase, or add notes and Repo indexes first.

similarityTitle.zh-TW: 向量餘弦相似度，用來排序，並非正確率。
similarityTitle.en: Similarity score used for ranking, not accuracy.
